usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.projects.list(limit: 20, after: "after", include_archived: false)
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.admin.organization.projects.list(limit: nil, after: nil, include_archived: nil) -> Page<Models::Project>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: include_archived
fields.description: If `true` returns all projects including those that have been `archived`. Archived projects are not included by default.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.project`

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the project. This appears in reporting.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the project was created.

fields.name: external_key_id
fields.description: The external key associated with the project.
